rows.baseline_step: Queue intake, filters, status tabs and one row-to-workspace action
rows.wms_screen_zone_action: /app/ff/fbs; current queue header/filters/status tabs/table; open existing workspace
rows.official_ozon_step: Read unfulfilled/list postings and track provider status/substatus/actions

official_evidence.paraphrase: The FBS workflow begins from provider postings and their current fulfilment state.
Current Seller API exposes FBS posting list/detail operations.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: Posting identity and status can populate the current queue and open the same workspace.

rows.wms_screen_zone_action: Existing FBS workspace; Состав table product/order/quantity cells
rows.official_ozon_step: Represent posting product lines, quantities and package/split identity

official_evidence.paraphrase: Assembly operates on a posting and its product/package data.
Partial assembly preserves posting/package distinctions.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: Multiple current table rows and the existing quantity cell can show the work without replacing columns.

rows.wms_screen_zone_action: Состав; one Начать работу с поставкой action
rows.official_ozon_step: Begin local picking/packing before provider assembly confirmation

official_evidence.paraphrase: Ozon provides picking-list/assembly guidance but does not prescribe a separate WMS start control.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: The physical start of warehouse work is provider-neutral; provider ship confirmation is later adapter work.

rows.wms_screen_zone_action: Подбор; location scan, product scan and manual cell pick
rows.official_ozon_step: Physically pick products in the posting

official_evidence.paraphrase: The official flow supports a picking list but does not impose a distinct cell-picking interface.
Picking precedes preparation and handover of the posting.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: Current WMS scans and stock movements perform the required physical work.

rows.wms_screen_zone_action: Existing Маркировка column and existing Упаковка и маркировка row controls
rows.official_ozon_step: Provide required exemplar/marking data before assembly for products that demand it

official_evidence.paraphrase: The FBS workflow includes product-specific mandatory exemplar/marking requirements before assembly.
Assembly cannot complete when a posting-specific mandatory requirement is unmet.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: The current marking zone is sufficient, but a generic WB value cannot satisfy a different Ozon-required exemplar value.
rows.hard_incompatibility_proof: Official FBS workflow blocks assembly when required exemplar/marking data is absent or invalid; applicability is product/posting-specific.
unknowns: Exact required fields for the owner's real postings are unknown without an authorised read-only posting.

rows.wms_screen_zone_action: Упаковка и маркировка; current pack controls and progression
rows.official_ozon_step: Confirm full or supported partial package

official_evidence.paraphrase: The current full assembly operation confirms a prepared posting.
The current partial operation supports a package subset.
Physical packaging remains seller work before handover.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: The physical pack action remains the same; provider package identity and mutation are adapter mechanics.

rows.wms_screen_zone_action: Existing packing print zone and per-order print/apply flow
rows.official_ozon_step: Generate and apply the current Ozon posting label

official_evidence.paraphrase: Seller API provides the current task-based FBS label-generation operation.
Ready postings are prepared with their labels for handover.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: The same print zone is sufficient, but a WB sticker or internal WMS barcode is not an Ozon posting label.
rows.hard_incompatibility_proof: Official Ozon FBS handover requires the provider posting label and exposes a dedicated label-generation operation.
rows.allowed_delta_kind: conditional label/print asset in existing print zone
unknowns: The concrete label size/format is account/method configuration and must not be guessed.

rows.wms_screen_zone_action: Короба; current WMS box creation/content and existing handover area
rows.official_ozon_step: Hand ready postings over one by one by posting barcode

official_evidence.paraphrase: Current guidance permits per-posting handover without mandatory common-shipment formation.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: WMS boxes can remain physical grouping while posting/package identity is mapped separately.

rows.wms_screen_zone_action: Existing handover/footer action; no separate carriage stage

official_evidence.paraphrase: Transport documents remain available for applicable handover cases.
Per-posting handover is available, so common-shipment formation is not universal.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: No current official proof makes carriage an unavoidable operator step for every posting.
unknowns: Whether the concrete delivery method requires an act, pass or carriage is unknown; capability remains disabled.

rows.wms_screen_zone_action: Current status tabs and row state
rows.official_ozon_step: Read provider state after physical handover and scanning

official_evidence.paraphrase: The official workflow distinguishes provider fulfilment states after assembly/handover.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: Provider state can map to the current groups while raw status remains internal.

rows.wms_screen_zone_action: Current cancelled group and safe recovery paths
rows.official_ozon_step: Cancel/partially cancel or recover only when the posting state permits it

official_evidence.paraphrase: Available recovery/cancellation depends on the concrete posting state and actions.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: No universal extra action is proved; current state projection is sufficient until capability is known.
unknowns: Concrete cancellation/recovery action availability is unknown without an authorised entity read.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: Current PackagingTask and WMS boxes perform the physical work; external identities can be linked behind them.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: Distinct identity does not prove universal route applicability or a separate operator action.
unknowns: Concrete route/TGM requirement is unknown; TGM action remains disabled.

rows.wms_screen_zone_action: Existing per-box print zone/menu in Упаковка
rows.official_ozon_step: Generate/apply Ozon cargo and transport-cargo labels for configured entities

TGM is a distinct provider entity in applicable supplies.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: The same print zone is sufficient, but internal WHB is not an Ozon cargo/TGM label.
rows.hard_incompatibility_proof: Official FBO flow includes provider label printing for configured GM/TGM; applicability and exact asset set are supply-specific.
rows.allowed_delta_kind: conditional label/print asset in existing print zone

rows.wms_screen_zone_action: Existing document footer/handover completion
rows.official_ozon_step: Deliver the supply at the selected point/timeslot and read provider state afterward

official_evidence.paraphrase: The supply request determines destination/timeslot for handover.
Provider supply status is reconciled separately from local physical completion.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: The current handover footer remains one physical action; provider confirmation is readback data.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: Readback fits current metrics; beta method existence does not prove a universal manual WMS action.

rows.wms_screen_zone_action: Existing cancel footer and status display
rows.official_ozon_step: Cancel/edit only when provider state/action permits and reconcile async status

Supply edit/cancel operations have separate provider status/results.

rows.why_existing_action_is_sufficient: The existing cancellation zone can be conditionally enabled; no new recovery panel is needed.
rows.allowed_delta_kind: conditional enabled state/copy in existing action
unknowns: Concrete available action is unknown until an authorised entity read.

rejected_elements.reason: No official hard incompatibility; existing pick panel performs the physical action and scanner filling is another method.
Physical packing remains the existing PackagingTask/WMS-box flow.
Provider identities, lines and quantities fit existing cells through data mapping.
Endpoint/entity existence does not prove a mandatory operator click; supply-specific rules are unknown.
TGM is distinct but route-dependent; no concrete unavoidable physical action was proved.
Mandatory data/package state belongs in existing packing rows/actions.
Existing boxes stage remains the physical flow; posting identity maps behind it.

architect_handoff: Remove REJ-01 through REJ-07 without replacing them with renamed panels.
Preserve current routes, modal roots, stage counts, table structures and single progression actions.
Keep provider posting/package/supply/cargo/TGM/label/act identities behind provider-neutral projections; never rename WMS box as Ozon cargo.
Allow only requirement-driven fields in existing marking controls and provider labels in existing print zones; hide or disable until concrete official entity data proves applicability.
Keep FBS carriage, explicit FBO cargo/TGM actions and act acceptance capability-off by default.
Carry UNKNOWN rows as blockers; resolving them requires a separately authorised read-only integration probe, not owner questions or credential access during architecture.
